“Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you…

translations.web: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead
translations.asv: And Jehovah will scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left few in number among the nations, whither Jehovah shall lead you away.
